description: This file contains unit tests for the `OptionalType` class in C++, verifying its behavior such as default construction, copy, assignment, and value retrieval using Google Test framework.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: Template class representing an optional value that may or may not be set, with methods to check state, retrieve, and clear the value.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the stored value, resetting the object to a state where no value is set.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Returns whether the optional contains a value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Retrieves the contained value, assuming it is set.
